exposure: Oligohydramnios (AFI <5 cm or single deepest pocket <2 cm)
cohort: The study included 188 pregnant women diagnosed with oligohydramnios between 28 and 42 weeks of gestation.
finding: Oligohydramnios is associated with a high rate of operative deliveries, increased neonatal morbidity, and adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the predominant mode of delivery (69.1%) in pregnancies complicated by oligohydramnios, largely due to fetal distress.
birth_weight: N/A (no specific inclusion criterion; 53.19% of neonates had low birth weight <2.5 kg)
